route: Table 2 CFA loadings per code + Table 3 composite (route 3); no route for wording->code
evidence: verify_zhang_2024_attractiveness.R fetches the live table (325 respondents, all complete): one-factor CFA standardized loadings ATR1-4 = 0.775/0.829/0.817/0.946 vs paper Table 2 0.778/0.830/0.815/0.946 (max |diff| 0.003; best non-identity permutation 0.014); ATR composite mean/SD 3.847/1.027 vs Table 3 3.847/1.027. This pins the live codes to the paper's own ATR1-4 and shows items are stored raw, 1=Strongly disagree..5=Strongly agree. It does NOT establish which appendix wording belongs to which code: the appendix numbers items 1-4 without printing codes, and the paper publishes no per-item statistic keyed to wording; all four are same-polarity agreement items. The wording->code tie rests on appendix numbering alone.

route: id-level live-vs-S1 column match + Table 2 CFA loadings + Table 3 scale mean
evidence: Route A (code -> S1 column): verify_zhang_2024_gift_intention.R fetches the live table (975 rows) and PLOS S1 Dataset .xlsx; live INT1/INT2/INT3 each agree id-for-id 325/325 with the same-named S1 column and with no other of the 23 item columns (best other: INT1 vs INT3 215/325; INT2 vs INT3 208/325; INT3 vs INT1 215/325). Route B (S1 column -> paper Table 2 code): 6-factor CFA standardized loadings recomputed from S1 0.831/0.797/0.934 vs Table 2 INT1 0.831, INT2 0.797, INT3 0.934 (|diff|<0.0005); a swap of any two codes would shift loadings by >=0.034. Scale mean/SD 3.716/1.022 vs Table 3 3.716/1.022. What the routes do NOT establish: that Appendix item k (numbered 1-3 under 'Gift-giving intention', no INT codes printed) is Table 2's INT<k> -- that tie rests on numbering order alone and the three items' content predicts no statistic that could test it; nor that the English matches the administered Chinese. Hence PARTIAL.

What the route does NOT establish: that Table 2's PSI<k> is the k-th numbered item of the S1 Appendix's 'Parasocial interaction' list -- the appendix prints no codes, so that tie is presentation order and untestable from data; nor that the English matches the administered Chinese.
